_sources.area: James's wording, decided 2026-09-23: "Orange County, California", never a city

fyt.name: Fyt
fyt.tagline: Social fitness app for iPhone and Apple Watch

_sources.users: read-only query of the production database counting app users, excluding the developer's own account; 379 on 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24
_sources.commits_since_2026_05_01: git rev-list --count HEAD --since=2026-05-01 in the Fyt repository (3425 on 2026-09-23; first commit is 2026-05-01)
_sources.swiftui_files: Swift files importing SwiftUI in the Fyt iOS app (283 on 2026-09-23)
_sources.stack: the Fyt API's package.json (fastify, drizzle-orm, pg-boss) and its Fly.io config
_sources.updates_since_launch: the App Store listing's version history: 25 releases from 1.0.17 (2026-07-07) to 1.0.43 (2026-09-21), after the launch release; re-check by counting the listing's dated version entries
_sources.chat_posts, chat_posts_since: read-only query of the production database: announcements with sent_to_imessage_at set (count, earliest date): 438 posts since 2026-05-09 on 2026-09-24, covering 346 distinct workouts (a workout can be posted to more than one group chat), so the page says "workout posts"
_sources.background_upload_since: version 1.0.43 release notes and App Store listing: a run finished on the Watch reaches Fyt in the background; only workouts recorded by Fyt's own Watch app
_sources.app_store_url: the App Store lookup's trackViewUrl for id 6783633047, read 2026-09-24
_sources.site_url: Fyt's public website, which James built
